feature.buildCorpusMeaning: Original compiler-source corpus authenticated by the native build, not the target workload manifest. Binary/C/all protected and loaded original sources must remain present and hash-identical.
feature.implementation: Authenticate original native build with authenticateNativeSeedBuild; independently validate complete ordinary workload source/foreign manifest; canonicalize only workload manifest path metadata; delegate unchanged native_compiler_experiment.ts --mode=run --phase=check --threads=1; preserve raw native report.

pairedStatistics.scope: Different backends by design; native/JS operational cost ratio, not compiler algorithm or JS optimization speedup. CPU scopes differ and no CPU ratio is computed.

measurements.interpretation: Both observed native runs faster/lower footprint; n=2, broad wall CI and large temporal spread do not qualify a stable speedup or 25s guarantee. Native second parse/expand wall also rose. No measured host-load/thermal/scheduling/I-O cause. CPU scopes differ, so no cross-backend CPU ratio is asserted. Upfront native build is excluded.
